name: Certification Campaign Started (Legacy)
description: Notify user that a certification has been activated.
subject: Action required: Review your employees' access
body:
Certification campaign started

Dear ${user.name},

Your system administrator has started the ${certification.certificationGroups.get(0).name} certification campaign. This campaign lets each reviewer confirm that users have the correct entitlements.

Review deadline
Please complete your review by $spTools.formatDate($certification.expiration,3,0). For each user, approve, change, or revoke access as appropriate.

In your certification, you will see:

  • The entitlements each user has
  • The sources those entitlements come from, when available
  • The applications users can access because of those entitlements, when available

Open your certification to begin the review: Review certification.

Thank you for helping keep access accurate in Identity Security Cloud.
